exposure: duration of insulin treatment (1-7 days, >14 days)
cohort: The study included 29,974 infants 22 to 32 weeks gestational age admitted to over 300 neonatal intensive care units from 1997 to 2018 and diagnosed with hyperglycemia.
finding: Insulin use among premature infants with hyperglycemia significantly decreased over time, and differing durations of insulin treatment were associated with adverse outcomes including treated retinopathy of prematurity, chronic lung disease, and death.
